protocol.purpose: User-authorized bounded correction-quality pilot; no automatic full training
protocol.training: Scratch, eight envs, 125 rollout steps, batch200, epochs10, lr0.0003,gamma0.99,GAE0.95,[64,64],log_std=-2; fixed-scaled20 observations, reward-only VecNormalize. Same nominal random-sine reset distribution and reward from ExecutionEnv. No domain randomization. Service_ticks=0 for BOTH arms to isolate gate execution, rather than confound training delays. New arm sees actual frozen gate/history; direct arm immediately adds proposed residual with weight1 and exposes its actual execution context. All other code/settings shared. SB3 effective reset seeds model.seed+i, matching both arms.
protocol.treatment: Only the action execution rule differs during training: direct residual versus frozen performance gate. Both learned policies deploy through the identical frozen gate with20 features at evaluation. Context differences caused by execution are part of this treatment; not an independent observation-dimension ablation.
protocol.reward: Unchanged ExecutionEnv tracking+effort+change+survival+privileged relative_bonus of ACTUALLY executed command. Both arms receive the same reward definition; true plant parameters only enter physical/reward branches, never actor or deployed gate.
protocol.noise_formula: base + seed_index*10000 + speed*100 + path_index*10 + scenario_index; indices in declared order; same across methods
protocol.evaluation: Fresh development noise; three training seeds x three speeds x two known paths x six regions x six methods. Initial lateral0.15m/heading0.01rad. ceil((220/speed+2)/0.01) ticks. Same Fiala/RK4/actuator/sensor estimator for all. Actor, gate, LQR and MPC use measured speed. PPO and MPC get the same three curvature previews; LQR remains its unchanged local-curvature design. Single-worker simulated service delays apply to learned/constant candidates; local LQR/MPC command each tick. Report solver/inference wall times, not real-time claims. No reserved noise or native simulator use.

mpc.type: Nominal linear dynamic bicycle plus first-order actuator, constrained convex QP, OSQP0.6.3
mpc.terminal: discrete Riccati cost at cached observed speed
mpc.curvature: linear interpolation/extrapolation-clamp of actor previews at0/10/20m; no additional future map or hidden parameters
mpc.bounds: full command/actuator ±0.5rad; |u-delta_predicted_before_command|<=0.35*0.05rad to respect initial lag derivative limit; actual shared plant rate limit unchanged
mpc.solver: eps_abs/rel1e-5,max_iter3000,warm start; infeasible/unconverged or >1e-4 constraint violation falls back to same local LQR and is counted. No post-result tuning.

protocol.primary_progress_rule: Execution mean penalized RMSE >=1% lower than direct, better in >=2/3 paired seed means; no regional survival loss against direct or LQR; nominal <=2% worse than LQR; no active region >1% worse than LQR; exact100ms LQR command/trajectory equality.
protocol.learning_benefit_rule: Additionally >=1% overall reduction vs LQR and BOTH predeclared constants. Do not count time samples as independent. Report all methods/regions even on failure.
protocol.mpc_advantage_rule: >=1% mean reduction vs MPC, all three seed means lower and no regional survival loss; separate from primary training-effect decision.
protocol.stop: Always stop after these100k checkpoints and development report. No extra arm, hyperparameter search, best-checkpoint selection or budget extension based on outcomes. Full training remains a separate decision.
protocol.limits: Three seeds and known geometries; descriptive paired uncertainty only. MPC is a declared nominal constrained reference, not an exhaustive best-tuned nonlinear MPC benchmark. This experiment tests execution alignment under fixed nominal training, not every possible AI correction method. No safety/stability or physical deployment claim.
